latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Ad Producer skill, enabling automated, platform-optimized video ad creation from a text brief via the InVideo AI platform.

- Generate professional video ads from product or campaign briefs, including script, voiceover, visuals, captions, music, and CTA.
- Export ads in optimal formats for Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, and YouTube Ads, supporting multiple aspect ratios and localization options.
- Automatically write scripts using proven frameworks (AIDA, PAS, BAB, Hook+Proof+CTA) based on campaign goal.
- Produce and export multiple ad variants for A/B testing and platform targeting using the InVideo API.
- Includes guide for setup, API access, usage examples, and parallel generation of ad variants.
